integrity: The regular simplex rank-one case and its known formula are explicitly credited. All higher-rank statements are supported by an analytical proof and finite rational reproducibility checks. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The claim concerns intrinsic Euclidean directional width of hypersimplices and positive diagonal rescalings, not lattice width, inradius, combinatorial diameter, or all matroids. For the weighted case the formula is a finite subset minimum, with no polynomial-time complexity assertion. Full historical priority remains provisional.
title: A quadratic minimum-width transition for hypersimplices and its weighted partition formula
